title: Drake Maye: I love playing for Mike Vrabel, that's not going to change

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Drake Maye: I love playing for Mike Vrabel, that's not going to change
sources.description: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel dismissed a report that he has issues with quarterback Drake Maye during a Wednesday press conference by saying that coaching Maye is the reason he's in New England and Maye got his chance to comment on it later in the day.
